G1 checkpoint Purpose: This checkpoint is like the starting line for the cell cycle. Check: The cell checks if it has enough nutrients, energy, and the right signals to start dividing. Decision: If everything is good, the cell moves to the next stage (S phase). If not, it might pause or go into a resting state.
